# Kodera

> Open-Core organisation workspace: Web, native clients, signed extensions and operator-owned Community deployment.

This is a source-oriented local pre-cutover reference for kodera-hq/kodera. Linked source URLs identify the target repository; public publication and community.kodera.io availability are not confirmed. Read the linked guides for scope and integration limits.

Core API 0.44.0; Agent API 0.6.0; OpenAPI 3.1. The console calls authenticated Core only. Matrix/Synapse rooms and LiveKit grants are control-plane responsibilities, not local-preview authority.

Community uses Docker Compose and an external operator-owned HTTPS OIDC issuer/public trust registry. It brings no identity provider. No installation-time or memory-footprint claim is made.

The create-kodera package is a local pre-release. Run node packages/create-kodera/bin/create-kodera.mjs --selftest from a checkout. After publication: npx create-kodera --self-host --domain chat.example.org --oidc-issuer https://id.example.org/realms/studio --oidc-client-id console --template audiovisual-production --dry-run. The kodera-deploy executable aliases the same CLI. The repository shell entry is bash deploy/community/kodera-deploy.sh; real generation requires public-trust.json. Configuration generation does not provision live channels or start services.

@kodera/extension-sdk 0.1.0 uses HMAC-SHA256, v1= signatures over timestamp.rawBody, a 300-second window, bounded in-memory signature/delivery replay protection and signed body routing metadata. Native GitHub sha256= signs rawBody and is not wire-compatible. Production needs durable idempotency and resolved-address egress policy; lexical SSRF checks do not pin DNS.

synapse-policy 0.1.6 enforces room policy. kodera-rs provides bounded native identifiers/metadata/codecs and ProximityFrame v1. Ed25519 verification is not membership or measured proximity; TTL is unsigned. Native MLS/radio/hardware seams are not finished integrations. Web sound synthesis uses 48000 Hz; this is not a shipping Rust audio-hardware claim. kodera-theme:v1: is bounded visual metadata, not encryption or authority.

Clients/Rust/SDK: Apache-2.0. Server and Synapse policy: AGPL-3.0-or-later. Enterprise Edition: separate commercial licence. Never commit environment secrets, private keys or real tenant identifiers. No secrets belong in prompts, example payloads or theme codes.

Exactly twenty-two reference connector implementations are indexed below; this is not a list of live connected accounts. External providers outside this list remain potential custom SDK integrations, not additional reference connectors in this checkout.

## Developer guides

- [Quickstart & self-hosting](/developer-docs/en/quickstart.md): Prepare your workspace. Keep identity and deployment under your control.

- [Extension SDK & 22 connectors](/developer-docs/en/extensions.md): Bring signed events into channels, with explicit trust boundaries.

- [API reference & webhooks](/developer-docs/en/api.md): Read the pinned contracts before sending a request.

- [Architecture & security](/developer-docs/en/security.md): Understand what ships, what is bounded, and what remains an integration seam.

## French guides

- [Quickstart & auto-hébergement](/developer-docs/fr/quickstart.md): Préparez votre espace. Gardez la maîtrise de l’identité et du déploiement.

- [Extension SDK & 22 connecteurs](/developer-docs/fr/extensions.md): Amenez les événements signés dans les salons, avec des frontières de confiance explicites.

- [Référence API & webhooks](/developer-docs/fr/api.md): Lisez les contrats épinglés avant d’envoyer une requête.

- [Architecture & sécurité](/developer-docs/fr/security.md): Comprenez ce qui existe, ce qui est borné et ce qui reste à intégrer.
